name: babu-studio-app
description: A macOS creator studio built with Electron, React, and a C++ media core.

scripts.build:core: cmake -S core -B core/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build core/build --config Release
scripts.test:core: cmake -S core -B core/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DBUILD_TESTING=ON && cmake --build core/build --config Debug && ctest --test-dir core/build --output-on-failure
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace @babu-studios/electron
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @babu-studios/electron
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run bundle:media && npm run package:mac --workspace @babu-studios/electron
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @babu-studios/electron && npm run typecheck --workspace @babu-studios/renderer
